Looking for a portable cabin in Ghaziabad for a school classroom, a site office or a security post? A portable cabin is a factory-built steel-frame room with insulated panel walls that arrives ready to use, so you avoid months of on-site construction. As a manufacturer dispatching from our Greater Noida factory, SAMAN Portable builds and delivers across Ghaziabad — including Raj Nagar Extension, Indirapuram, Vaishali and Mohan Nagar. Call +91 88616 22859 for a quote.

What a Portable Cabin in Ghaziabad Costs (and What Drives the Price)

There is no single fixed price, because a portable cabin is built to your size and use. For an accurate quote, the main cost factors are the floor area in square feet, the panel type and thickness, the level of insulation, whether a toilet or internal partition is added, the electrical fit-out, the exterior finish, and the delivery distance to your Ghaziabad site. Tell us your use-case and size, and we send a costed quote — no guesswork.

Because we manufacture the units ourselves and dispatch from Greater Noida, you buy factory-direct without a local middleman margin. Request a quote and we will break down the price line by line.

Portable cabin price guidance in Ghaziabad

Most Ghaziabad buyers want a starting figure before they enquire. Exact pricing depends on size, the wall panel you choose, the interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your site — so the figures below are indicative starting points, not fixed quotes. We confirm the firm price at quotation once we know your size and use.

As a guide, a compact 6x6 ft security or guard cabin typically starts around ₹1.25 lakh. A 10x10 ft site office works out higher once flooring, wiring, and windows are added. A 10x20 ft office with a built-in toilet block sits higher again, and a large 30x10 ft team office is at the top of the standard range. PUF sandwich panels cost more than single-skin or cement board but insulate far better through Ghaziabad's hot summers. GST applies on top, and the standard delivery charge from our Greater Noida factory is ₹3,000.

Portable cabin (indicative)Typical use
6x6 ftSecurity / guard cabin, site post
10x10 ftSingle-room site or warehouse office
10x20 ft with toiletStaff office with attached washroom
30x10 ftMulti-room team or admin office

These bands match what SAMAN publishes for the same steel-cabin build elsewhere. Tell us your exact size and finish and we will send a clear, itemised quote.

Common Uses Across Ghaziabad

A portable cabin is flexible enough to serve very different needs around the city. The most common buyer requests in Ghaziabad are:

  • School classrooms: insulated, well-lit rooms that schools in Raj Nagar Extension use to add capacity without a long build.
  • Site and project offices: durable cabin offices for construction and infrastructure teams across Vaishali and Crossing Republik.
  • Security posts: a portable cabin used as a security post or guard room at residential society and commercial entrances in Indirapuram and Mohan Nagar.
  • Clinics and small offices: hygienic, partitioned units for satellite clinics or temporary commercial space.

Sizes and Configurations

Portable cabins are built to order, so the layout follows the use. A single guard post may be a compact unit, while a classroom or office needs a larger floor plate. You can specify the dimensions, window and door positions, internal partitions, electrical points, and whether a toilet is included. Multiple units can also be placed side by side and connected to create a larger combined space — useful when a school expands classroom by classroom.

Every portable cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections, with roughly 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls at 40 kg/m³ density as standard, or cement fibre board for a more economical build. Sizes are made to order — the figures above are the common ones, but we build to your exact footprint, whether that is a narrow guard cabin for an Indirapuram society gate or a multi-room office for a Raj Nagar Extension construction site.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it: split AC points and extra power sockets for office use, internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting area, a toilet and washbasin block built into the unit, a glass front for a reception or gate cabin, loft storage above the ceiling line, and anti-skid flooring for workshop or wet areas. Because every unit is one of our factory-built portable cabins, these are made into the build, not added on afterwards.

How Our Portable Cabins Are Built

Every cabin is built to a consistent manufacturer specification rather than assembled on site:

  • Structure: MS (mild steel) frame to IS 2062, powder-coated for corrosion resistance.
  • Walls and roof: approximately 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum density) with a pre-galvanised steel skin, which keeps the inside cooler through Ghaziabad summers.
  • Roofing: GI roof sheeting designed to shed monsoon rain.
  • Quality system: manufactured under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we have completed 500+ projects across India.

Delivery and Installation in Ghaziabad

Ghaziabad sits within easy reach of our Greater Noida factory, which is a real advantage for delivery time and transport cost. Standard delivery is charged at ₹3,000, with road transit typically of 3–5 days once your unit is ready; custom or fully fitted units take longer to build before dispatch. On arrival, the cabin is positioned on your prepared site — a level base is usually all that is needed, with no deep foundation for a standard single unit. We deliver across Raj Nagar Extension, Indirapuram, Vaishali, Mohan Nagar and the wider Ghaziabad area.

For dry-assembly factory-built cabins, work is generally not barred during the GRAP construction-restriction windows that apply across the NCR in winter — but confirm site-specific rules with your local authority before placement.

Ghaziabad is one of our shortest delivery routes. Your cabin is built and finished at our Greater Noida factory, then trucked across the NH-9 / Hindon corridor to your Ghaziabad site — usually within the standard 3 to 5 day window, often faster given the short distance. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base — a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground — ready before delivery.

Why Buy Factory-Direct from SAMAN

Buying straight from the manufacturer means clear pricing, control over the build, and a real warranty position. Every unit carries our standard cover: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.) We also offer a 7-day return window from delivery, with return transport paid by the customer.

FAQs: Portable Cabins in Ghaziabad


How long does delivery take to Ghaziabad?

Once your unit is built, road transit from our Greater Noida factory to a Ghaziabad site is typically 3–5 days. Standard custom builds with full fit-out take longer to manufacture before dispatch, so share your requirement early for an accurate timeline. Standard delivery is charged at ₹3,000.


What drives the price of a portable cabin?

Price depends on floor area, panel type and thickness, insulation level, whether a toilet or partition is added, the electrical fit-out, the exterior finish, and delivery distance. Because every cabin is built to order, we provide a costed quote against your exact specification rather than a fixed list price.


Can a portable cabin be used as a security post in Indirapuram?

Yes. A compact portable cabin works well as a security post or guard room at society and commercial entrances. It can be specified with the window positions, lighting and electrical points your security team needs. Tell us the location and we will recommend a suitable size.


Do I need permits to install a portable cabin in Raj Nagar Extension?

A portable cabin is a relocatable structure, so requirements are usually simpler than for permanent construction, but rules vary by site and use. OWNER FACT NEEDED: confirm what SAMAN does/does not do regarding Ghaziabad Development Authority permits before publishing. Always confirm local requirements with the authority for your specific site.


What sizes are available?

Cabins are built to order, from a small single-occupant guard post to larger classroom or office floor plates. You set the dimensions, partitions, doors, windows and whether a toilet is included. Multiple units can be joined to form a larger combined space.


What warranty comes with the cabin?

Our standard cover is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.

Get a Quote for Your Portable Cabin in Ghaziabad

Whether you need a classroom in Raj Nagar Extension, a site office in Vaishali or a security post in Indirapuram, we can build it and deliver it to your site. Call +91 88616 22859 or message us on WhatsApp at +91 88616 22859 with your size and use-case for a costed quote. You can also browse our full portable cabin range or see our office portable cabin options online.
